title: Hoshino Ichika — Hoping For Clear Skies〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The day of the cherry blossom picnic
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We actually got good weather...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Did our weather charms really work...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahh... It's so sunny!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How many times are you going to say that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's past twenty already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No I haven't...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we start getting everything ready then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lunch, snacks, juice... All set♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, all that's left is...
Thanks for waiting, Miku, Luka, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Don't mind us. We've just been chatting the whole time.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If anything, we should be the ones thanking you for inviting us.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that you guys could come along to see the cherry blossoms with us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh... Luka, MEIKO, look!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wow! They really are in full bloom...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, they're so beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get our cherry blossom viewing picnic started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, then everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki & Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Hona, this is amazing!
Fried chicken, omelets and bite-size Salisbury steaks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It really is! It's almost like it could be in a recipe book!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to today, so I spent yesterday making everything I could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mmm... These Salisbury steaks are so good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I made plenty so have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I made some rice balls too if anyone would like some...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh oh... They've sort of lost their original shape and turned into balls...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did have to carry everything over here, but I'm sure they're still okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I probably should've wrapped them up a little tighter.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I think they look cuter this way!
Mind passing me one, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hnng...!!
I-It's so sour!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You got one with an umeboshi in it.
How about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, if she also gets one of these, we get to see her sour face!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, I got a salmon one.
Honami, can I have another Salisbury steak?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Go right ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How many have you had already, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not sure. I just don't want to miss out on these.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair!
I'm not gonna let you hog them all, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's still plenty more where that came from, Saki. Here's one for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They look like they're having fun.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They do! And thank goodness it didn't rain either!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Let's keep watching over them.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, the cherry blossoms...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they're so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me... Didn't we used to play a game to see who could catch the most petals?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! Wow, talk about a blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, wanna try doing that now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we just finished eating...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, now we need to work it off!
Everyone, stand up! You too, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Then how about the first to catch one is the winner? Also, we're allowed to play defense.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That sounds wonderful! Have fun, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, would you mind being the starter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sure. On your marks...
Get set... Go!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No! It slipped through my fingers...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There! You're mine...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Saki...?!
Are you blowing them away from us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Shiho said we could do this, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hwah! Hiho?! What are you yooing?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This counts as defense too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo, nawt my heeks...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was a little worried about the weather and how things would turn out, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to do this.
